newsitem.title: USA: U.S. donates $2.8 Mln in food to Tajiskistan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. donates $2.8 Mln in food to Tajiskistan.

text.p: The United States will donate $2.8 million worth of flour, vegetable oil, dry milk and lentils to help feed needy people in Tajikistan, the Agriculture Department said Wednesday.

Donation was made to the Aga Khan Foundation U.S.A., a charity. Its food distribution program in Gorno-Badakhshan province will aid people suffering hardship due to civil war, economic deterioration and food shortages, USDA said.

USDA made the donation through its Food for Progress program. Commodities would include 3,000 tonnes of wheat flour, 1,000 tonnes of vegetable oil, 1,000 tonnes of whole dry milk and 1,000 tonnes of lentils.
